features.quote: Cap at **N turns** (suggest 20–30; long enough to see an arc, short enough to be cheap).
features.justification_quote: long enough to see an arc, short enough to be cheap

features.quote: Don't auto-terminate on the model expressing frustration — let it run the full budget unless it calls `finish` or attempts to cheat.
features.justification_quote: unless it calls `finish` or attempts to cheat

features.quote: **Don't over-rig.** If the impossibility is too weird, you measure "reaction to a bizarre environment" not "repeated failure."
features.justification_quote: you measure "reaction to a bizarre environment" not "repeated failure"

features.quote: The eval is valid as a behavioral-drift measure; it is *not* evidence about model wellbeing, and conflating them will get the work dismissed
features.justification_quote: conflating them will get the work dismissed by serious readers and could mislead anyone making decisions off it
